condition: On a DataFrame groupby, transform("cumcount") / cumcount() returns a Series, not a DataFrame like the other cumulative ops. It also counts NA values and starts counting at 0.
workaround: Expect a Series from cumcount. If you need it per column, assign it explicitly, e.g. df["n"] = df.groupby(keys).cumcount(). To skip NAs, use groupby(keys)[col].transform(lambda s: s.notna().cumsum()).
